scripts.build:landing: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:content && vite build --mode landing
scripts.build:full: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:content && vite build --mode full
scripts.lint: eslint scripts && prettier --check src scripts tests vite.config.ts index.html countdown/index.html eslint.config.mjs
scripts.capture:screenshots: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:content && node scripts/capture-screenshots.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests vite.config.ts index.html countdown/index.html eslint.config.mjs
